title: The first gap may matter later
hook: A locally convenient bin can leave the wrong shape of free space.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Offline optimum versus online decisions; cost and approximation ratio.
doesNotKnow: Place each arriving item in the first feasible existing bin and distinguish the online packing from optimal packing.

misconception: First fit always uses the fewest bins when every item individually fits.
objective: Place each arriving item in the first feasible existing bin and distinguish the online packing from optimal packing.

claims.text: First Fit cannot move earlier items to repair a later packing. The two fours share the first bin, leaving too little room for either six. Reordering those same items permits two full bins; the volume lower bound alone does not force this online algorithm to attain it.
